subject.title: Add an FxTwitter read transport for public lookups, threads, profiles, and search

question: Should Birdclaw core officially support an opt-in FxTwitter/FxEmbed public-read transport and accept responsibility for its privacy, endpoint-trust, reliability, and compatibility contract?
rationale: Source inspection establishes a feasible architecture but cannot determine whether this third-party public service belongs in the repository’s supported core transport set.

options.title: Approve bounded core transport
options.body: Accept an explicit opt-in, public-read-only adapter with self-hosting support, strict capability separation, privacy documentation, and no automatic fallback.

options.title: Keep existing transports only
options.body: Decline the new core integration and retain bird/xurl as the supported live transport boundary.

options.title: Defer service commitment
options.body: Leave the proposal open until FxTwitter’s API stability and long-term support expectations are better established.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded core transport
recommendation.body: Accept an explicit opt-in, public-read-only adapter with self-hosting support, strict capability separation, privacy documentation, and no automatic fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner, steipete is the best available authority for expanding Birdclaw’s supported transport and privacy contract.
